notes:
v1.4.23 "Watchman"

• The app can no longer get stuck and stop uploading — every server request now fails on its own within a minute if the connection dies, and a stuck sync round is force-released after 10 minutes (this is what froze the ER counter's upload queue for hours on the 21st)
• Patient registrations now follow the desk user across PCs — "My registrations" shows your patients no matter which computer you registered them on
• Big uploads (backups) keep a 10-minute window so slow connections still finish
